title: WebGPU Deferred MSAA in Rust: Manual 4x Resolve with wgpu
description: Build 4x MSAA deferred shading in WebGPU with Rust and wgpu: store four G-buffer samples, shade each with six lights, and manually average the result.
imageAlt: Animated rabbit-like Jax character walking across a checkerboard floor under colored lights with 4x deferred multisampling.
